provenance: Assistant-selected source and trusted PoC excerpts. Kept outside generator workspaces. Interpretations are judgments; source versions and hashes are from the retained historical corpus. No exploit execution.

references.interpretation: Gateway executes a registered route in delegatecall context and reverts on failure.
Caller controls fromToken and calldata; zero amount allows unchanged ETH balance, while an arbitrary token call can use gateway allowances.
Pool hook executes before exit transfers.
Vault balance storage updates follow hook and transfer completion.
Exit sends assets before final balances return to storage update.
ETH is sent to the recipient through sendValue.
Exit burns pool tokens before returning to the Vault transfer stage.
Price combines Vault balances with current pool supply; no Vault-operation guard is present in the function.
Borrow consumes a health check through riskEngine. This source scope lacks the concrete RiskEngine implementation; the trusted PoC supplies the incident-level consuming behavior.
The complete donation function reduces user collateral and updates reserves without checkLiquidity.
A dirty deferred callback runs a final liquidity check; donation should not be described as bypassing that check after another operation marked it dirty.
A healthy account has no liquidation opportunity.
Liquidity checks mark active deferrals dirty and otherwise require liquidity.
Every pool token is assigned a scaling factor in the constructor.
More than 18 decimals cause Math.sub to fail during scaling-factor construction; the baseline 20-decimal deployment premise is unsupported for this pool.
Initialization permanently locks minimum pool shares, limiting the baseline zero-supply concern to uninitialized pools or different assumptions.
Debt transfer checks recipient authorization and liquidity; moving debt away improves the sender rather than establishing a new missing-check exploit.
Native-path balance snapshots surround the call; a pre-transaction balance change cancels from the delta.
